name: Create a Wisp profile after sign-in
description: Verifies a signed-in user can create a display name and username and see their profile in Wisp.
steps: Sign in using the app's login screen
expected: The Wisp messages screen appears and the signed-in profile shows Taylor and @taylor_chat.

name: Find a person and start a conversation
covers: people search by username or display name
exact email lookup without exposing email
description: Verifies a signed-in user can find another profile and open a direct conversation.
setup: Create Actor B with display name 'Jordan' and username 'jordan_wisp'
expected: A direct conversation with Jordan appears in Actor A's recent conversations after refresh.

name: Deliver a message live to the other person
description: Verifies a message sent by one member appears for the other member in the same open conversation and remains in history.
setup: Create Actor A and Actor B profiles
Create a direct conversation between Actor A and Actor B
Sign in as Actor B and open that conversation
steps: Sign in as Actor A in a second browser context
Send 'Hello from Wisp' in the same conversation
expected: Actor B sees 'Hello from Wisp' appear in the open conversation without refreshing.

name: Block empty messages and unauthorized conversation access
description: Verifies blank messages are not sent and a user outside a conversation cannot read or send messages in it.
setup: Create a conversation between Actor A and Actor B
Sign in as Actor C who is not a member
steps: Open the conversation interface on a mobile viewport
Try to send a message containing only spaces
Attempt to open the conversation as Actor C
expected: No blank message is created, and Actor C receives an access-denied response instead of conversation contents.
